Method of Attack: Ransomware encrypts victim files using AES encryption with a password received from Command & Control servers
Deletes Shadow Volume Copies to prevent file recovery
Creates ransom notes in each folder with encrypted files
Connects to external IP geolocation service to gather victim IP and location
Sends victim information (hwid, tracking ID, computer name, user name, country, IP) to Command & Control servers
Encrypts files on mapped drives with targeted file extensions, skipping system and program files directories
Impacted Systems: Windows systems with mapped drives containing targeted file extensions
Attack Vector: Execution of ransomware binary (distribution method unknown)
Indicators of Compromise: Command to delete shadow copies: WMIC.exe shadowcopy delete /nointeractive
